ANGPTLS and GPIHBP are novel and important modulators of LpL function and plasma TG levels.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ANGPTl3 and 4 are inhibitors of plasma TG clearance by LPL and that the GPIHBP1-LPL complex is the functional unit of LPL-mediated lipid metabolism in vivo.
ANGPTl3, ANGPIt4 and GPIHBBP1 play a critical role in the regulation of LPL function, and that the balance of these proteins is important in the maintenance of plasma TG homeostasis.
GPIHBP1 and ANGPTl4 are the two most important factors that determine plasma LPL activity and thereby TG clearance.
